prompt.content: Who was the catcher for whom room was made on the roster when Russell Branyan was activated from the bereavement list on May 3, 2007?

output:
When Russell Branyan was activated from the bereavement list on May 3, 2007, the Mariners made room on the roster by removing a player from the active roster and placing Russell Branyan on the roster. The catcher who was removed was **Jose Tabata**.
